question: To which practitioners and invoked powers does this mantra belong?
premises: The thunderbolt and others are invoked.
This mantra belongs to right-hand-path practitioners.
inference: This mantra, invoking Indra and the thunderbolt among others, belongs to right-hand-path practitioners.
plain_english: Invoking Indra and others, and the thunderbolt and others, this mantra belongs to those of the right-hand path.
